conversation: A: Guess who I saw yesterday?
B: Katy Wilson?! I don't think I remember her.
A: I sure, you do. She is the one who saved my life when I almost drowned.
B: Of course, now I remember her. How is she?
A: No, really. We just spoke for a minutes. It was really good to see her again.
